1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

As a Network Architect, in the Network Team, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, in the functional domain of Evolved Packet Core and 5G SA Core. You will be responsible for preparing, designing, testing, and delivering new solutions or enhancements to the existing product portfolio. Additionally, you will define and support the technology evolution roadmap for systems within the assigned functional area and domain, while also actively participating in and supporting cross-functional projects in collaboration with other functional areas.

Key Responsibilities
  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry. Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives
RequirementsMust Have
  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of Packet Core systems, including P-GW, RADIUS, DNS, PCRF, ePDG, DRA
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining roaming interconnects for GRX/IPX
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Experience in deploying VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience in designing, implementing, testing and troubleshooting the following interfaces: Gx, RADIUS, SGi/Gi, Gy, Bp, S6b, S2b, SWm, Sxb
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online).
  • Experience in Policy control, including DPI and PCRF policy creation
  • Experience with IoT, including LTE-M and NB-IoT
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as RADIUS, GTP-C, GTP-U, Diameter, MAP, S6a
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
Nice to Have
  • +8 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • +3 years in a telecom strategy role
  • Experience in 5G Core design, implementation and operation
  • Previous experience with Nokia and Aironed Networks EPC products
Benefits
  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica —50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave —180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old —R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!
Why 1GLOBAL?
  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts

Salário

Descritivo Sumário (Resumo da Posição)

O(a) Contador(a) Sênior será responsável por gerenciar as operações contábeis e fiscais de 53 CNPJs, abrangendo tanto a matriz quanto as filiais. Este profissional deverá realizar um estudo aprofundado sobre o regime tributário de cada empresa, com foco na migração de regime para lucro presumido ou lucro real. Atuará em todas as demandas típicas de um escritório contábil, incluindo emissão de holerites, notas fiscais, elaboração de DRE, balanços, balancetes, além de garantir o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais, como Darf, Dirf, INSS, FGTS e parcelamentos de impostos. Além disso, o(a) Contador(a) Sênior deverá ter conhecimento aprofundado das novas regras da reforma tributária que entraram em vigor em 2025, aplicando esses conhecimentos para ajustes tributários estratégicos e garantindo a conformidade fiscal. Será responsável pela abertura de novos CNPJs, pelo estudo contínuo das condições fiscais de cada empresa e pela gestão das obrigações tributárias de forma estratégica e eficiente.

Requisitos (Hard e Soft Skills)

Hard Skills (Requisitos Técnicos):

  • Formação superior completa em Contabilidade.
  • Experiência comprovada em contabilidade para múltiplos CNPJs, com ampla vivência em regimes tributários (Simples Nacional, Lucro Presumido, Lucro Real).
  • Experiência na emissão de holerites, notas fiscais e elaboração de DRE, balanços e balancetes.
  • Domínio de parcelamentos fiscais, incluindo PGFN, Darf, Dirf, e gestão de parcelamentos de impostos.

  • Conhecimento profundo da reforma tributária de 2025, aplicando as novas regras fiscais no planejamento e gestão tributária dos CNPJs.
  • Domínio de sistemas contábeis e fiscais (como SCI, Contmatic, Nucont, SuperSoft).
  • Proficiência intermediária a avançada em Excel e ferramentas de gestão contábil.

Soft Skills (Competências Comportamentais):

  • Perfil analítico com capacidade de realizar estudos aprofundados sobre regimes tributários e otimização fiscal.
  • Proatividade para identificar e implementar soluções de redução de custos fiscais e melhoria de processos.
  • Liderança e capacidade de organização para gerenciar múltiplos CNPJs simultaneamente, assegurando que todas as obrigações sejam cumpridas dentro dos prazos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação assertiva, especialmente em relação a equipes internas e consultores externos.
  • Senso de responsabilidade com o cumprimento de obrigação tributária e contábil.
  • Resiliência para lidar com situações de complexidade fiscal, incluindo negociações e parcelamentos com órgãos governamentais.
Responsabilidades
  • Analisar e revisar o regime tributário de cada CNPJ, propondo a migração para Lucro Presumido ou Lucro Real, de acordo com o perfil e necessidades de cada empresa.
  • Emitir holerites e realizar todas as obrigações relacionadas ao departamento pessoal.
  • Emitir notas fiscais (quando necessário) e garantir a conformidade tributária das emissões.
  • Elaborar Demonstração do Resultado do Exercício (DRE), balanços patrimoniais e balancetes mensais e anuais.
  • Abertura de novos CNPJs para filiais ou novos negócios, garantindo o correto enquadramento tributário.
  • Estudo periódico e análise do regime tributário, sugerindo ajustes e mudanças quando necessário para maximizar a eficiência fiscal, com foco nas novas regras da reforma tributária de 2025.
  • Gerenciar e organizar o parcelamento de impostos, especialmente quando necessário junto à PGFN e outros órgãos competentes.
  • Emissão de INSS, FGTS, Darf, Dirf e demais obrigações fiscais relacionadas.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias (eSocial, SPED, entre outros).
  • Acompanhar de perto todos os processos fiscais da empresa, garantindo o atendimento à legislação vigente e a redução de riscos fiscais.

description:

Meio período · Trabalho remoto

Uma Marca Fundada em Inovação, Confiança e Crescimento Sustentável

Na WPP Media Studio , acreditamos no poder do marketing digital para gerar conexões reais e duradouras. Nosso compromisso com a excelência e inovação nos permite ajudar marcas globais a alcançar seus objetivos, maximizando o impacto e a relevância no mundo digital.

Agora, para fortalecer nossa equipe de marketing digital, estamos em busca de um Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (SEM) altamente qualificado. Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por resultados, com uma visão estratégica e foco em performance, queremos que você se junte a nós para construir o futuro do marketing de busca e e-commerce.

Por que esta função é importante?

O marketing de busca é uma das pedras angulares das estratégias de marketing digital, especialmente no e-commerce. Como Estratégista de Marketing de Busca , você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de SEM (Search Engine Marketing) que impulsionam o tráfego, aumentam a visibilidade da marca e, acima de tudo, geram conversões para nossos clientes.

Esta função é essencial porque:

  • Impulsiona a visibilidade digital e o tráfego qualificado para as marcas com as quais trabalhamos
  • Maximiza o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) de campanhas de mídia paga através de otimizações contínuas
  • Gerencia e executa campanhas de Google Ads, Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca , garantindo máxima eficiência
  • Contribui diretamente para a estratégia de e-commerce , gerando resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis

Seu trabalho terá um impacto direto no crescimento e no sucesso contínuo de nossos clientes no universo digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Estratégias SEM

  • Criar estratégias eficazes para campanhas de Google Ads , Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca
  • Gerenciar a execução e otimização de campanhas de SEM, focando em aquisição de tráfego e conversões
  • Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave , análise da concorrência e monitoramento de tendências de mercado

Otimização de Desempenho

  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente campanhas com o objetivo de melhorar o CPC (Custo por Clique) , CTR (Taxa de Clique) e ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento)
  • Utilizar dados de Google Analytics e outras ferramentas analíticas para avaliar o desempenho das campanhas
  • Conduzir testes A/B para aprimorar a performance das campanhas e o conteúdo dos anúncios

Análise e Relatórios

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o desempenho das campanhas e fornecer insights acionáveis aos clientes
  • Traduzir dados e métricas de desempenho em recomendações claras para ajustes nas campanhas
  • Monitorar a configuração de pixels de rastreamento , ações de conversão e outras métricas relevantes

Colaboração e Comunicação

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as equipes de criatividade , conteúdo e e-commerce para garantir a consistência da marca e a eficácia das campanhas
  • Manter uma comunicação aberta com os clientes, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o progresso das campanhas
Qualificações Necessárias
  • Experiência comprovada em marketing de busca com foco em Google Ads e Bing Ads
  • Sólido conhecimento de SEO (Search Engine Optimization) e SEM (Search Engine Marketing)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e outras ferramentas de monitoramento de desempenho
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e fazer ajustes para melhorar resultados de campanhas
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente com um alto nível de precisão e atenção aos detalhes
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com clientes
  • Trabalho remoto com autonomia e alta responsabilidade
Experiência Preferencial

(Não obrigatória, mas será um diferencial)

  • Experiência com plataformas de publicidade programática e remarketing
  • Certificações avançadas em Google Ads e Microsoft Advertising
  • Conhecimento de otimização da taxa de conversão (CRO) e criação de páginas de destino eficazes
  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce e em campanhas digitais que geram receita
Benefícios e Cultura de Trabalho

Na WPP Media Studio , nossa cultura se baseia na confiança, transparência e no trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que nossos colaboradores devem ter o espaço e a flexibilidade para prosperar. Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto flexível : você poderá trabalhar de qualquer lugar, com horários flexíveis
  • Crescimento profissional contínuo : oportunidades para aprimorar suas habilidades e influenciar a estratégia de marketing digital
  • Ambiente colaborativo : uma equipe dinâmica e engajada que trabalha com sinergia para alcançar os melhores resultados
  • Foco no impacto : trabalhamos para gerar valor real para nossos clientes e construir parcerias de longo prazo
  • Cultura missionária : nosso compromisso é sempre com a qualidade, inovação e resultados sustentáveis
  • Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o impacto real que nossos colaboradores fazem na transformação digital de nossos clientes.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes.   • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.

  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:
WIZ.AI 's suite of generative AI-powered omnichannel customer engagement solutions is trusted by 260+ global clients to enhance customer experience, improve customer outreach, foster human-AI collaboration, increase business results, and attain higher cost savings. WIZ.AI's solutions automate ten million interactions every hour, helping businesses connect with their customers at the right time with the right message through the right channel . Through its distinct product suite, WIZ.AI offers global reach while facilitating local expertise to its clients.



Job Duties:

  • Understand customer business requirements and work with project teams to provide tailored Talkbot solutions on the WIZ AI Talkbot Platform, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule.
  • Develop and implement test suites to check AI conversations on the WIZ talkbot platform, oversee the corpus validation, conduct exploratory testing, and coordinate pilot tests with customer teams.
  • Monitor and maintain the AI conversation experience, resolve user feedback issues, and determine underlying causes.
  • Build and maintain a database of industry-specific conversation scripts based on completed projects, continuously updating and improving the content to enhance AI conversational abilities.
  • Work with clients to identify the text responses they require for the talkbot.
  • Create text responses designed to enhance user interactions with the bot.
  • Update and refine text responses according to customer feedback and interaction patterns.



Requirements:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in conversation design, product management, customer success manager, business analyst, chatbot designer.
  • Demonstrated experience in defining and optimizing conversation design workflows and processes.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and client-facing skills, with the ability to articulate complex design decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven expertise in a leadership or managerial role, including leading project teams and mentoring colleagues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to design and optimization.
  • Experience with software, chatbot, or analyst testing is a significant plus.


Why Wiz.AI?


At WIZ.AI, you won't just witness the cutting edge of Generative AI. You will define it, engineering proprietary Talkbots and advanced LLMs that deliver transformative, measurable impact for global

enterprises across 17 countries. We offer an unparalleled ground-floor opportunity within a hyper-growth market leader.


Our flat, results-driven culture ensures technical brilliance translates directly to strategic influence,

rewarding your unlimited potential with industry-leading, results-driven compensation.


Elevate your career beyond iteration. Come build your best career story with us.

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.


Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.


Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating hybrid cloud + on-premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:

-Datadog (or similar observability platforms)

-AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)

-Containerization (Docker)

-Kubernetes / K3S

-IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)

  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on-call processes, or follow-the-sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware-integrated systems (ideal).


About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast-moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi-Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.


Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.


Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.

title: IT Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Role: IT APM Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate

Duration: 12+ Months


We are seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer to support our enterprise architecture and application rationalization efforts using LeanIX. This role is critical in capturing, analyzing, and maintaining application metadata to assess current technology usage, align future business requirements, and guide decisions on modernization, consolidation, or new application development. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote India or Brazil.


Why This Role Matters:

This role directly supports our enterprise-wide transformation by enabling smarter technology investments, reducing redundancy, and aligning IT capabilities with business strategy. You’ll play a key role in shaping our future application landscape.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

LeanIX Data Stewardship

  • Populate and maintain accurate application data within LeanIX, including ownership, lifecycle, business capabilities, and technical attributes.
  • Ensure completeness and consistency of metadata across the application portfolio.


Application Rationalization

  • Evaluate applications for business value (e.g., strategic alignment, user impact, cost efficiency).
  • Assess technical value (e.g., scalability, integration readiness, security posture, supportability).
  • Identify candidates for retirement, consolidation, or modernization.


Technology Mapping & Future Planning

  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to map future business requirements to existing technologies.
  • Support decision-making on whether to enhance current platforms or build new applications.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with application owners, enterprise architects, and business analysts to gather insights and validate data.
  • Facilitate workshops and reviews to ensure alignment on application strategy and lifecycle decisions.


Reporting & Insights

  • Generate dashboards and reports from LeanIX to support executive decision-making.
  • Provide insights into portfolio health, redundancy, risk, and optimization opportunities.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3+ years of experience in application portfolio management, enterprise architecture, or IT asset management.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanIX or similar APM tools.
  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle, business capability modeling, and technology stack analysis.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is required.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.

title: Data Modeler
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Modeler will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

title: Especialista de Arquiteto de Soluções
description:

Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;

Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;

Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;

Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;

Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;

Emitir e conferir relatório “Administração de Obras”, montar RP e enviar ao financeiro corporativo com as notas e documentos exigidos pelo cliente;

Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;

Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;

No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;

Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia.

Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;

Experiência anterior em rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;

Excel intermediário ou avançado;

Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;

Facilidade de comunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas.


Desejável:

Conhecimento em Sienge;

Experiência em obras com múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;

Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;

Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira.

description:

This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI-driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI-powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self-service needs.
  • Continuously analyse chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

title: Especialista de Recursos Humanos (Desenvolvimento Organizacional)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Missão do cargo:

Atuar como especialista em Desenvolvimento Organizacional e Business Partner, garantindo a efetividade do ciclo de gestão de pessoas e a construção de um pipeline sólido de sucessão. Ser responsável por conduzir e qualificar processos de performance, feedback e PDI, traduzindo dados em indicadores estratégicos que orientem decisões da alta liderança. Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização.


Responsabilidades do cargo:


  • Conduzir e garantir o ciclo de gestão de pessoas - contratação de metas e avaliação de performance e comportamental;
  • Realizar Calibração - metodologia 9box; Assessment - avaliação comportamental;
  • Acompanhar e garantir feedback de desenvolvimento dos gestores;
  • PDI ( Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - acompanhamento dos resultados individual e em grupo, com mapeamento de ações e demandas de desenvolvimento e reconhecimento;
  • Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
  • Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento de times, como teambuilding, dinâmicas de grupos, etc.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Grau de instrução mínimo: Ensino Superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos e/ou áreas correlatas; Pós-graduação em andamento ou completo;
  • CNH B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e Powerpoint, diferencial Power BI e/ou painel de indicadores;


Desejável: Ter atuado com SAP - módulo SuccessFactors.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 2+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.


You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.


At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.



REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.



What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually
